question: Which of the following parts of a file is the part fitted to the tang for holding the file?
solution:
The correct answer is __Handle****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Handle__ is the part of a file fitted to the tang for holding the file.
 
• The tang is the pointed portion of the file that connects to the handle.
 
• The handle is typically made of wood, plastic, or rubber for easy grip and comfort during use.
 
• Handles provide the user with better control and reduce the risk of injury during filing operations.
 
• Proper attachment of the handle to the tang ensures efficient usage and longevity of the file.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tip or Point:**
 
 
• This is the end of the file used for filing narrow spaces or corners.
 
 
 
• **Tang:**
 
 
• The tang is the pointed part of the file inserted into the handle.
 
• It helps in attaching the handle securely to the file.
 
 
 
• **Edge:**
 
 
• The edge of a file is used for precision filing in tight areas.
